_comment: Used by assets/ruby/sponsor_utils.rb normalize_href to count each sponsor company once.
Hostnames are first collapsed to their registrable domain with the Public Suffix List
Then these aliases apply, checked in order: the exact hostname; its registrable domain;
then '.tld' keys, which match any host under a brand top-level domain like .panasonic.
Map a hostname to itself to exempt it from subdomain collapsing.
Policy: merge renames, country variants, and brand domains of the same company;
keep separately-run subsidiaries separate (github.com is not microsoft.com).
